summary: Phase 21 landed and closed clean, exactly at its Scope Hypothesis (5 defs, 20 theorems, one edited definition body, zero new modules) and exactly on decision D-g's route 1. GHR's printed Case 2 right-hand side and the printed-form siblings of Cases 3, 6, 7 and 8 are additive, every landed signature is byte-identical, and sepSnce's rebuilt body keeps its name, signature and both lemma statements. The deliverable Phase 20 excluded is reinstated as the proved witness isUTyped_sepSnce, so GHR Lemma 10.2.4 now carries both halves of its conclusion and uTypeCount is well-posed over the snce-side layer. All gates measured green: full guarded lake build (exit 0, zero errors, 2960 jobs), zero sorry, zero introduced vacuous definitions, no new axiom, check-module-invariants.sh ALL CHECKS PASSED, check-metalogic-cycles.sh exit 0, typst-sync-check.sh --fix PASS. Phase 22 was sized per the plan's own instruction and deliberately not opened: it needs a plan revision first, for the two undecomposed prerequisites and the route question recorded in blockers.
blockers: Phase 22 needs a plan revision before an implementation dispatch. (a) GHR 10.2.5's precondition has no landed predicate: IsUTyped A B is strictly too strong, since its snce constructor demands IsSOnly arguments -- no untl under any snce -- which is exactly the restriction 10.2.5 relaxes, so a third predicate plus its Boolean closure lemmas is forced and the plan's Files-to-modify row does not name it. (b) Inducting on snceDepthAbove needs a hasUntl decision and a one-level rewriting operator applying 10.2.4 at the deepest snce-containing-an-untl, with four lemmas about it; neither is in the task list, and both are prior to the three-part obligation the plan does decompose (which attaches to 10.2.6/10.2.7/10.2.8, not 10.2.5). (c) Route question, for planning not implementation: a structural-recursion route to 10.2.5 needs no measure at all, because usTruth_sepSnce and the now-landed isUTyped_sepSnce compose directly at every snce node, and it is strictly cheaper than the specified measure route. plan-compliance.md forbids an implementation dispatch substituting it silently, so it is reported rather than taken.
